description: Source code for LayoutPsiPullParser class implementing an XML pull parser based on IntelliJ PSI XmlTag for Android layout rendering.

classes.name: LayoutPsiPullParser
classes.description: Main class implementing a PSI-based XML pull parser for Android layout files, supporting navigation through XML elements and attributes.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents an XML element with attributes, children, and namespace information.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of an XML element, including namespace, prefix, name, and value.

classes.name: AttributeFilteredLayoutParser
classes.description: Subclass of LayoutPsiPullParser that filters attribute values based on a provided AttributeFilter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of LayoutPsiPullParser or its subclasses based on parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentNode
methods.description: Returns the current XML element being parsed.

methods.name: getPreviousNode
methods.description: Returns the previous XML element in the parsing stack.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from the current element by index.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new element onto the parsing stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element from the parsing stack.

methods.name: getViewCookie
methods.description: Returns the underlying XmlTag object for the current element if view cookies are enabled.

methods.name: getViewKey
methods.description: Legacy method returning the same as getViewCookie.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Returns null; placeholder for embedded parser.

methods.name: getPositionDescription
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current position in the XML document.

methods.name: getAttributeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the current element.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute at a given index.

methods.name: getAttributeNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the attribute at a given index.

methods.name: getAttributePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the attribute at a given index.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the attribute at a given index.

methods.name: getAttributeValue (overload)
methods.description: Returns the value of an attribute given its namespace and local name.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth in the XML element hierarchy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current element, with special handling for <fragment> tags.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the current element.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the current element.

methods.name: isEmptyElementTag
methods.description: Returns true if the current element has no children.

methods.name: onNextFromStartDocument
methods.description: Initializes parsing state from the root element.

methods.name: onNextFromStartTag
methods.description: Advances to the next element or end tag.

methods.name: onNextFromEndTag
methods.description: Moves to sibling or parent element during parsing.

methods.name: setProvideViewCookies
methods.description: Enables or disables returning view cookies.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates an Element snapshot from an XmlTag, handling special tags like <fragment> and <FrameLayout>.

methods.name: createTagSnapshot
methods.description: Creates an Element snapshot from an XmlTag, including attributes and children.

methods.name: createAttributeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates an Attribute object from an XmlAttribute.
